description:
Advances: ancora.gate

Severity: Medium (calibrated; critical review 2026-09-05, consolidated F38, performance). Evidence: the ancora-gg8.7 closure-copy regression (15x slower at 818 files, invisible at 67) passed every test and merge gate because nothing measures the gate at scale; the performance reviewer built a synthetic 818-file corpus from real Elixir sources to find it. Proposal: a generated-corpus bench (mix task or test tagged :bench) with a wall-clock ceiling run in CI or nightly, so a quadratic regression fails a check. Needs a policy call on the ceiling and where it runs. Related: ancora-u38 cache revisit bench. Ready-for: investigate.
title: Scale bench: generated large corpus with a CI wall-clock ceiling for the gate
